messages.content: What are your opening hours?
The studio is open Tuesday to Saturday, 10am to 9pm. We are closed on Sundays and Mondays.
When is the studio open?
Tuesday to Saturday, 10am to 9pm. Closed Sundays and Mondays.
How much is a beginner wheel course?
The beginner wheel course is six weekly sessions of two hours and costs £210, including clay, glazes and two firings.
Do I need experience for the beginner course?
No. The beginner wheel course assumes you have never touched clay. Wear clothes you don't mind getting muddy.
What is a taster session?
A taster is a single 90-minute session on the wheel for £45. You make two pieces and we fire and glaze them for you; they're ready to collect after three weeks.
How long until I can collect my pots?
Allow three weeks. Pieces need to dry, go through a bisque firing, get glazed, then go through a glaze firing.
What clay do you use?
Our house clay is Saltmarsh Buff, a mid-fire stoneware that fires to cone 6. It's smooth with a little grog, which makes it forgiving on the wheel.
What temperature do you fire to?
Bisque firings go to cone 04, about 1060°C. Glaze firings go to cone 6, about 1220°C.
Can I bring my own clay?
Only if it's a cone 6 stoneware and you show us the manufacturer's data sheet first. Earthenware and porcelain from outside the studio are not allowed in our kilns.
What does membership include?
12 kg of house clay each month, a shelf, use of all wheels and tools during open studio hours, and unlimited firings of house clay.
When is open studio time?
Members can use the studio during open studio: Tuesday to Friday 10am to 6pm and Saturday 1pm to 9pm.
Do you sell gift vouchers?
Yes. Gift vouchers are available for any amount from £25 and are valid for 12 months. They can be used for tasters, courses or membership.
Is there parking?
There is no parking at the studio itself. The nearest car park is the Quayside car park, a four-minute walk away.
Is the studio wheelchair accessible?
The ground floor, including two wheels at adjustable height and the accessible toilet, is step-free. The glaze room upstairs is not.
Can children take classes?
Children aged 8 to 15 can join the Saturday morning kids' club, 10am to 12pm, £22 per session. Under 8s are welcome at family tasters with an adult.
What is the minimum age for the adult courses?
Adult courses are for ages 16 and over.
Do you do private parties?
Yes. Private wheel parties are for 4 to 8 people, last two hours and cost £50 per person. Hen parties are welcome; you can bring your own drinks.
Can I bring alcohol to a party?
Yes, private parties can bring their own drinks. We provide glasses. No drinks are allowed near the wheels during normal classes.
Which glazes do you have?
We have eight house glazes: Tidepool (blue-green), Oat (satin white), Shino Orange, Tenmoku (glossy brown-black), Clear, Celadon, Rust Speckle and Midnight (matte black).
Are your glazes food safe?
All eight house glazes are food safe when fired to cone 6 on our clay. Midnight is matte and can mark with cutlery, so we recommend it for outsides.
Why did my glaze crawl?
Crawling usually means the bisque was dusty or greasy, or the glaze was applied too thickly. Wipe pieces with a damp sponge before glazing and keep the glaze to the thickness of a credit card.
Why did my pot crack while drying?
Usually uneven drying. Cover handles and rims with plastic so they dry at the same speed as the body, and compress the base well on the wheel.
How do I book a class?
Book on the website under Classes. Courses fill up about three weeks ahead, so book early. If a course is full, join the waiting list.
I missed a course session. Can I make it up?
You can make up one missed session per course by coming to an open studio slot. Ask the teacher to sign your card.
Do you fire work made elsewhere?
Yes, firing service for outside work costs £8 per shelf for a bisque or glaze firing, cone 6 stoneware only. Drop work off on Tuesdays.
When are kiln firings?
Bisque firings run every Monday and glaze firings every Thursday. Work on the firing shelf by Sunday night goes into Monday's bisque.
Who teaches the classes?
Maya runs the studio and teaches the evening courses. Tom teaches the daytime and Saturday courses, and Priya runs the kids' club.
Do you sell finished pottery?
Yes, there is a small shop by the door selling work by Maya and members. Members get 70% of the sale price of their pieces.
What should I wear?
Clothes that can get muddy, short nails if possible, and tie long hair back. Aprons are provided.
Are tools provided?
Yes. Every wheel has a basic tool kit: sponge, wire, rib, needle tool and trimming tools. Members can store their own tools in their shelf.
Is there a discount for students?
Students and over-65s get 15% off courses and membership. Show your card when you book.
Do you have a waiting list?
Yes. Join the waiting list on the course page. We email in the order people joined when a place opens.
Can I glaze my pieces at home?
No, glazing has to happen in the studio so we know what goes into our kilns.
What happens if my piece breaks in the kiln?
Sorry when it happens. Kiln losses are part of ceramics, and we can't refund materials, but we'll help you work out why it happened.
How big can my pieces be?
Up to 40 cm tall and 35 cm wide to fit our kiln shelves. Larger pieces need to be agreed with Maya first.
Do you run hand-building courses?
Yes. The hand-building course is four Wednesday evenings, 6:30pm to 9pm, for £150. It covers pinch, coil and slab building.
Where is the studio?
Unit 4, Ropewalk Yard, behind the old harbour. Look for the blue door with the pot on it.
What are the studio notes on closing up the studio?

Turn off all wheels at the wall, wipe the splash pans, empty the slop buckets into reclaim, switch the extractor fan off last, and set the alarm with the code from the office. Check the kiln controller says either "firing" or "complete", never "error".
What are the studio notes on loading a bisque kiln?

Bisque pieces can touch and stack. Put bowls rim to rim, heaviest pieces on the bottom shelf, and leave two fingers of space between pieces and the elements. Run the "Bisque 04 slow" program, which takes about 10 hours plus cooling.
What are the studio notes on mixing Tidepool glaze?

Tidepool is mixed in 5 kg batches. Weigh dry ingredients from the recipe card in the glaze room, add to 4.5 litres of water, sieve twice through an 80 mesh sieve, and adjust to a specific gravity of 1.45. Label the bucket with the date.
What are the studio notes on teaching the first wheel session?

Spend the first 20 minutes on wedging and centring only. Most beginners push too hard; tell them to brace their elbow on their thigh and let the wheel do the work. Aim for one cylinder each by the end, even if it collapses.
What are the studio notes on trimming?
Trim when the pot is leather hard: firm enough to hold its shape upside down, soft enough that a fingernail leaves a mark. Too dry and the tool chatters; too wet and the pot distorts.
What are the studio notes on ordering clay?
Order Saltmarsh Buff from the supplier when we are down to 20 bags. A pallet is 40 bags and arrives in about a week. Store bags off the floor so they don't freeze in winter.
Hi! Is there space on the March beginner wheel course? My email is [EMAIL]
Hi [NAME], the March course is full but the April one has three places left. It's six Thursday evenings and £210 with clay and firings included.
hey do you fire stuff people make at home? call me on [PHONE]
Yes, we fire outside work for £8 a shelf per firing, cone 6 stoneware only. Bring it in on a Tuesday with a note of the clay you used.
My bowl came out of the kiln with bare patches where the glaze pulled away. What happened?
That's crawling. It usually means the bisque had dust or hand grease on it, or the glaze went on too thick. Wipe the piece with a damp sponge first and keep the glaze about as thick as a credit card.
What time are you open on Saturdays?
Saturdays we're open 10am to 9pm. Kids' club runs 10 to 12 and open studio is 1pm to 9pm.
Is the April course on Thursdays?
Yes, six Thursday evenings, 6:30pm to 8:30pm.
my handles keep cracking off my mugs, any tips??

Score and slip both surfaces well, attach the handle when the mug and handle are about equally leather hard, then wrap the handle in plastic so it dries slowly with the mug. Uneven drying is the usual cause.
Do you have gift vouchers? Want one for my sister's birthday
Yes! Any amount from £25, valid for 12 months, and they work for tasters, courses or membership.
whats the max size you can fire?
Up to 40 cm tall and 35 cm wide. Anything bigger, ask me first so we can plan a firing around it.
Which glaze is good for the outside of mugs but not inside?
Midnight, our matte black. It's food safe but cutlery can leave marks on it, so it's best on outsides. Pair it with Clear or Oat inside.
Is there anywhere to park nearby?
Not at the studio, but the Quayside car park is about a four-minute walk.
hi can I get a refund for the hand-building course, it starts next week
Full refunds are only up to 14 days before the first session, sorry. I can move you to the May hand-building course instead if that helps.
is porcelain ok in your kilns? I have some from another supplier
Sorry, no outside porcelain or earthenware in our kilns. Only cone 6 stoneware with a data sheet.
Maya the E1 error is showing on kiln 2 again
Don't restart it. Write down the firing number and message Tom, he has the spare elements. It's probably the bottom element going.
How much is a bag of clay for members?
£18 for a 12.5 kg bag of Saltmarsh Buff for members, £24 for non-members.
Can I come in on a Monday to practise?
We're closed Mondays, that's our bisque firing and cleaning day. Open studio runs Tuesday to Friday 10 to 6 and Saturday 1 to 9.
my friend is in a wheelchair, can she do a taster?
Yes. The ground floor is step-free with two adjustable-height wheels and an accessible toilet. We'll do the glazing downstairs for her too.
do you run anything for hen parties? there'd be 7 of us. my other number is [PHONE]
Yes, private wheel parties for 4 to 8 people, two hours, £50 each. You're welcome to bring your own drinks.
